text:
Ethan: hi all, day 1 here. i'm trying to run a small GPU job in europe-west4 to validate latency for a prototype but vm creation fails citing quota = 0 for accelerators. linked billing and project created under folders/801122. any tips?
Cloud Onboarding Bot: welcome Ethan! common causes: 1) GPU quota in GCP is regional and must be requested, 2) org may block GPU family in some folders, 3) billing needs to be active. paste the exact error and project id.
Ethan: error: 
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. Limit: 0.0 in region europe-west4 for metric 'GPUS'
project id: proj-ethan-day1
Samir (infra): hey Ethan 1. confirm billing account `gcloud beta billing projects describe proj-ethan-day1` and check the folder policy: `gcloud org-policies describe constraints/compute.allowedAcceleratorTypes --folder=801122 --effective`.
Ethan: billing shows linkedBillingAccount: 01F2-G3H4-I5J6. ran the org-policy command and it returned no explicit accelerator block.
Priya (billing): that billing account is correct and active for sandbox projects. quota is separate from billing.
Quota Bot: You can view regional quotas with: `gcloud compute regions describe europe-west4 --project=proj-ethan-day1 --format=\"json(quotas)\"` or check console: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=proj-ethan-day1. To request a quota increase, file a support request via GCP Console or open internal ticket QTA-2045-12 with desired accelerator type and units.
Ethan: what's the recommended accelerator type? i was going to use nvidia-t4s (type \"nvidia-tesla-t4\"). Any advice on requesting minimal quota for dev?
Samir (infra): request just 1 T4 in europe-west4 for 7 days and mark it non-prod. we'll fast-track if you include project id and justification \"dev latency test for SDK integration; no production data.\" Use internal quota ticket template.
Ethan: started internal ticket QTA-2045-12 requesting 1 x nvidia-tesla-t4 in europe-west4 for 7 days.
Quota Bot: Note: provider-side quota approvals can take 24-72 hours. In parallel, you can: 1) try another region with available quota (us-central1 often has spare T4s), 2) use preemptible GPUs to lower wait time where allowed, 3) use shared infra on the Dedicated dev pool if your team has reserved capacity (ask infra).
Samir (infra): i checked our Dedicated dev pool1we have a shared GPU node in europe-west4 reserved for infra tests. If you only need short runs, we can assign you a slot via SSH or a short-lived service account. Would you accept that while quota ticket processes?
Ethan: that would be perfect for initial validation. how do i get access?
Samir (infra): i'll create a short-lived service account `sa-dev-gpu-ethan@redwood-infra` with compute.instances.create and set expiry 48h. ticket ACC-2045-61 opened. Need manager approval for temporary access.
Ethan: manager approved in-thread: \"approve temporary gpu access for ethan for 48h\"
Priya (billing): FYI if you use shared infra make sure to tag any logs or datasets with `env=non-prod` to avoid accidental retention billing charges.
Nora (security): security note: do not upload private customer data to the shared node. Confirm you will use synthetic input.
Ethan: confirmed synthetic data only. thanks.
Samir (infra): created service account and added you to the access list; credentials posted in a secure ephemeral channel. try creating an instance using `gcloud compute instances create gtest-1 --zone=europe-west4-a --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 --project=proj-ethan-day1 --service-account=sa-dev-gpu-ethan@redwood-infra`
Ethan: tried it 1 instance spun up successfully using the shared pool. initial tests look good. i'll wait for the quota ticket but this lets me continue onboarding. :thumbsup:
Quota Bot: update: internal ticket QTA-2045-12 submitted to GCP; expected provider response 24-48h. We'll update thread when approved.
Samir (infra): once GCP grants quota i'll update the folder/project quota and remove the shared assignment. If anything breaks in the meantime ping me.
Ethan: awesome, thanks everyone for the quick help and the temp access. i'll delete the instance and creds when done and report back. :party_popper:
